name: finch-anydoc
description: Read Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF files as clean Markdown, right inside Finch.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx @finchtoys/minitools doctor .

finch.name: AnyDoc
finch.description: Read office documents and PDFs as clean Markdown.
finch.systemPrompt: Use anydoc_read_document to read the contents of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF files. Prefer it over writing conversion scripts. Call action=outline first on large or unfamiliar documents to see their structure, then action=read with offset to page through the parts you need. The first call on a new machine downloads a document engine of about 7 MB.
